current.text: He moved from Miami to Milwaukee in the Giannis Antetokounmpo trade.
Milwaukee's power forward group is very thin. He is listed as a projected starter next to Rollins, Herro, Ware and Turner.
He is expected to start at forward and play some minutes at the 3 and the 4.
He is seen as the former Miami player most likely to be traded before the season, possibly to Denver. A trade could change his role.
Much of his production last season came while two or three Miami players were out, Herro among them. Herro is now his teammate in Milwaukee.
Milwaukee's rotation is crowded and the experts cannot work out how the minutes will be split.

durable.text: One expert rates him as a low-end player, at best a sixth man, with bad shooting. In his view he needs opportunity and usage to produce.
He makes few threes for a wing. Threes are his weakest category for his position.

note: Both sites rank him at the edge of our 144-player pool (Yahoo 140, ESPN 148), with prices of about 1 USD. That makes him a last-dollar pick or a waiver option, best suited to punt 3PM builds that want FG%, assists and rebounds from a wing. The sites disagree on his efficiency: Yahoo projects 54.2% FG and 1.0 TO, while ESPN projects 50.2% and 1.9. Early in the season, check whether he starts at forward and whether he is traded.
